title: A Prelude to Us
excerpt: Mistake or was an act. But I saw tears in those eyes. For me. Or I just convinced myself of so.
content:
Mistake or was an act.

But I saw tears in those eyes.

For me. Or I just convinced myself of so.

It had to be for me. Because, I saw none near her. With us.

Time started to lose its shape, lost in the silence. The ticking of clock and the whirling of the fan became ache to our hearts. Nothing dared to move, nothing was conveyed, yet something passed between us, something stayed with us.

Maybe the imagination of those hearts who longed for each other or the mind that feared the passing of those cherished and priceless memories. The air hung heavy, as though the conclusion of feeling were imminent. Imminent? A goodbye, choked as we prepared to part. We wished our paths to meet again. But the abyss I am drowning in whispers otherwise, it’s better for our paths not to cross again.

But I saw it, in her eyes.

Those dark, moist eyes said a thousand things that I never learned to read. How could a man who had never loved recognize the language of a silent lover? I was the clown who never understood what was so desperate in those expressions, in those moments. When the feelings were unbearable and tears clouded my eyes, I left and she just sat there. Perhaps resenting herself for giving her heart to someone who never cared for it, someone who never understood that longing.

Never understood? How could I?

I recognized the pearls that were my life before. It’s just that I do not want to break another heart that I wished was mine. So, I kept smiling. Innocent. Convincing. A performance she never questioned.

Have I not lost enough?

Would I dare again to love?
